business-e2e-context

Business E2E map

How people use the system under test (tuDeclaracion.com) end to end: journeys first, then the feature catalog they cross. Read from the repository code and migrations, not from a live run.

Overview

tuDeclaracion has one human role: the accountant (an authenticated cuenta). A visitor who is not logged in can only see the landing page with its three example plans, sign up, log in and recover a password. The accountant files monthly DGI declarations for the client companies (empresa) registered under one login: it imports the monthly accounting TXT, reviews what will and will not be declared, and downloads the PADI file for DJ 2181 and DJ 1376, which is then imported into PADI by hand outside the app.

Role hierarchy: visitor (anonymous) -> accountant (authenticated). No admin, editor, viewer or second role exists in the code (no role enum, no requireRole or isAdmin guard); isolation between accountants is by data (Row Level Security on empresa.cuenta_id = auth.uid()), not by role. The permission matrix below is derived from middleware.ts and from the page guards.

CapabilityVisitorAccountant

Create and edit companies, configure the 1376 mappingNoYes
Import a TXT, review and download 2181 and 1376NoYes

See another accountant's companies or periodsNoNo (RLS)

Top journeys

  • journey-import-period (highest risk): the only step that writes period data. All-or-nothing parse, dollar-rate lookup against BCU, and a replace that deletes the previous lines. See flow-import-period in business-data-context.
  • journey-review-2181: turns stored lines into a regulatory file (per-RUT detail). A wrong amount or an excluded line is a filing error. See flow-generate-2181.
  • journey-configure-1376 and journey-review-1376: totals per line code depend on a hand-built mapping and on a provisional line catalog. See flow-configure-1376-mapping and flow-generate-1376.
  • journey-signup-verify, journey-login and journey-password-recovery: the entry gate, with email, captcha and Google steps that tests cannot drive, and one suspected defect (recovery link landing). See flow-account-access.
  • journey-create-company and journey-select-company: the setup that every other journey needs (RUT, plan de cuentas, active company cookie).
  • journey-delete-period: destructive, deletes the 2181, the 1376 and all lines together. See flow-delete-period.

Persona: visitor (not logged in)

Role the code recognizes: none. An unauthenticated request (supabase.auth.getUser() returns no user in middleware.ts). Evidence: middleware.ts (PROTECTED_ROUTES, AUTH_ROUTES) and src/app/page.tsx (public landing).

Persona: accountant (cuenta owner)

Role the code recognizes: an authenticated Supabase user whose cuenta row exists (created by the on_auth_user_created trigger). The product calls this person "contador" or "estudio contable" (domain map). One cuenta owns many empresas; there is no admin or second role (business-data-context, overview). Evidence: middleware.ts, supabase/migrations/20260712000000_baseline_cuenta_empresa.sql.

Entry point: Landing / ("Crear cuenta", or a plan button that goes to /signup?plan={id}) or a direct visit to /signup.

#StepEvidence
1Visitor opens /signup; a chosen plan is read from ?plan= and shown as "Plan {nombre}" with the 14-day trial text (display only).src/app/signup/page.tsx
2Visitor types email and a password; the four password rules turn green as they are met (BR-002).src/app/signup/page.tsx, src/lib/validation/password-rules.ts
3EXTERNAL DEPENDENCY: when a Turnstile site key is configured the captcha widget must produce a token before "Crear cuenta" is enabled (BR-005).src/components/auth/turnstile-widget.tsx
4Submit calls Supabase Auth signUp with emailRedirectTo = {APP_URL}/auth/confirm?next=/inicio and the plan as user metadata; the trigger creates the cuenta row.src/app/signup/page.tsx; business-data-context flow-account-access
5Screen shows "Revisa tu correo para continuar." (BR-004).src/app/signup/page.tsx
6EXTERNAL DEPENDENCY (email): the Send Email hook renders a Spanish email through Resend; the visitor clicks the link /auth/confirm?token_hash=...&type=...&redirect_to=....supabase/functions/send-email/index.ts
7/auth/confirm calls verifyOtp and redirects to next (default /inicio).src/app/auth/confirm/route.ts

BranchWhat the user sees or what happensEvidence
Empty email"Introduce un correo electrónico." (BR-001)src/app/signup/page.tsx

Failure points

  • The confirmation email is never delivered (hook disabled, Resend sender onboarding@resend.dev is a shared test sender): the app shows no error (integration-resend-email in business-data-context).
  • Unconfirmed login: whether staging requires confirmation is unverified (local config disables it).
  • The redirect_to / next mismatch suspected in business-data-context (integration-resend-email) affects recovery; for sign-up the link already carries no next in the email, so the default /inicio is the landing page (as intended).

Pointers: flow-account-access, integration-resend-email, integration-turnstile and the cuenta row of entities in business-data-context. API groups: future business-api-context (Supabase Auth).

Risk: High (security gate, three external dependencies that a UI test cannot drive: Turnstile, inbox, Resend).

Failure points

  • Replace deletes the old lines and resets the 2181 status to abierta, but the 1376 status stays generada (suspected defect in state-declaracion-1376, business-data-context).
  • A numeric Tipo other than 504 is silently turned into empty and a Tipo with letters is ignored by both declarations: no message tells the accountant (entity-asiento).
  • Importing for the 1376 also writes the 2181 row; the import type changes only how the file is parsed (flow-import-period).
  • The rate fallback and the daily rate cache depend on BCU being reachable (integration-bcu); a rate of 0 in the TXT is the trigger.

Risk: Highest (the only write of period data; destructive replace; all-or-nothing parse; external rate service; every downstream file depends on it).

Failure points

  • Recomputation drift (business-data-context discovery-gaps): the file is never stored, plan edits do not reset the status, so a period marked generada can yield a different file on the next download.
  • With exclusions present the badge stays "Con advertencias" even after the status was stored as generada, because the badge hides generada while exclusions exist (BR-058).
  • Two different half-down roundings apply (dollar conversion and final amount) (flow-generate-2181); the file content is the assertion that matters, not that a download happens.
  • "Última actualización" on the dashboard likely stays at the creation time (no updated_at trigger on declaracion).

Pointers: flow-generate-2181, state-declaracion, entity-declaracion in business-data-context. API groups: future business-api-context (no HTTP endpoint: Server Component read plus browser UPDATE under RLS).

Risk: Highest (regulatory output: a wrong amount or code is a filing error).

Cross-feature: a complete filing month (2181 plus 1376)

A complete filing month needs four features in sequence: a company with a 2181 plan (FEAT-009), a 1376 mapping (FEAT-012), an import (FEAT-014), then both reviews and downloads (FEAT-015, FEAT-016). The dashboard shows "Completo" for a period only when both declarations are generada, otherwise "Incompleto" (BR-055).

StepFeatureDependency on the previous step
1Create company and plan (FEAT-009)None. RUT and name required.
2Map the 1376 (FEAT-012)Needs the company. Without it the 1376 has no totals but the 2181 still works.
3Import the TXT (FEAT-014)Needs the 2181 plan rows (the parser cross-checks Libro against the account prefix) and, for dollar lines, BCU rates (FEAT-018 cache).
4Review and download the 2181 (FEAT-015)Needs lines. Creates no row; sets estado on download.
5Review and download the 1376 (FEAT-016)Needs the 2181 declaration and lines; creates its own row on open; needs the mapping for non-empty totals.
6Dashboard shows "Completo" (FEAT-013)Both statuses generada.

Failure points that cross steps: replace import resets only the 2181 status (the period can read "Completo" over new lines); the home page counts only 2181 abierta as pending, so a period with a pending 1376 does not appear in "declaraciones pendientes de generar" (BR-019, BR-055).

Cross-feature: editing rules after periods exist

The company's chart of accounts (plan_cuentas) and the 1376 mapping (mapeo_1376) are data, and both engines recompute from stored lines each time a review page opens. So an edit made in /empresas/{id} or /empresas/{id}/mapeo-1376 changes the exclusions, the totals and the file of every period already imported, with no warning and no status reset.

TriggerEffect on existing periodsWhat does not happen
Save company edit (FEAT-010)The 2181 resolution of every stored period changes the next time it is openedNo status reset; no message; the downloaded file of an earlier month is not marked stale
Save the 1376 mapping (FEAT-012)The 1376 totals of every stored period change the next time it is openedNo status reset; no message
Re-import with replace (FEAT-014)2181 status goes back to abierta1376 status stays as it was

Test implication: a regression suite that downloads a file, edits the plan and downloads again must expect a different file for the same period.

Cross-feature: contextual help from error messages

Error messages in the import, the 2181 review and the 1376 review carry a "Ver ayuda" link that opens /dashboard/ayuda#{anchor}, a page rendered from six Markdown articles in content/ayuda/: Primeros pasos, El archivo TXT, Errores al importar, Asientos excluidos del 2181, Mapeo del 1376, Situaciones especiales. Anchors are enforced by a unit test (anclas.test.ts: each anchor appears exactly once in the Markdown).

Discovery gaps

This map was generated from code only: no live database, no API schema tool and no browser session were used. Nothing below was run against staging.

Not verified

  • Sources: every route, step, message and rule comes from reading ../tudeclaracion/src/, middleware.ts, supabase/functions/ and the migrations (user-approved substitute for the database). No journey was executed; each step is cited to a file, none is confirmed by a run.
  • business-api-context is still a placeholder (generated next). The API inventory in inventory is therefore a pointer; the server surface (4 Server Actions, 2 route handlers, 1 Edge Function, 5 RPCs, direct table access) was read from code only, with no schema tool.
  • Test accounts: the QA repo .env.example declares LOCAL_USER_EMAIL, LOCAL_USER_PASSWORD, STAGING_USER_EMAIL and STAGING_USER_PASSWORD (also in .env.core.schema). Whether they are filled, whether the staging user is confirmed and whether it has a company, mapping and a period was not checked (values are never read). No variable exists for a second accountant (needed for tenant isolation tests) or for a fresh sign-up address.
  • Staging behaviour that code cannot show: whether the Send Email hook, Resend delivery, Turnstile enforcement, the Google provider and required email confirmation are on; the production URL and host.
  • Legacy inputs: the four legacy files listed for business-e2e-context in cli/lib/context-maps.ts (.context/business/business-feature-map.md, .context/PRD/user-personas.md, .context/PRD/user-journeys.md, .context/SRS/functional-specs.md) do not exist in this QA repo, so nothing was migrated from them. Product docs live in the target repo (.context/PRD, .context/SRS) and were not used as input beyond what the domain map already cites.
  • Libro value meanings (C, E, V, I, P) come from the SRS through the domain map, not from code.
  • Personas: the PRD names a secondary persona (a person filing without an accountant, per the domain map); the code has no separate role for it, so it is not a persona here.

Suspected defects found while tracing journeys (verified in code, not reproduced)

  • Login ignores ?redirect={path}: middleware adds it, no code reads it (BR-009). A deep link to a protected page ends on /inicio after login. Not covered in the data map.
  • /login?error=verification-failed and /forgot-password?error=expired render no message (BR-010, journey-password-recovery): an expired or bad link looks like a plain page load.
  • Reset password: a failing updateUser shows nothing, and the reset form does not trim the password while sign-up does (BR-002, BR-014).
  • Recovery link landing on /inicio instead of /reset-password (carried from business-data-context discovery-gaps, "Recovery redirect"; affects journey-password-recovery step 4).
  • Import replace resets only the 2181 status, so "Completo" can show over new lines (carried from state-declaracion-1376; affects journey-import-period step 6 and journey-review-1376).
  • Recomputation drift: a period marked generada can produce a different file after a plan or mapping edit (carried; cross-feature-plan-edit-drift).
  • Sidebar rate fallback likely returns the error state once several days are cached (carried, flow-usd-rate; BR-063). In addition /dashboard/cotizaciones calls BCU on every load without a local catch, so a BCU failure shows the generic error page (BR-064).
  • updated_at on declaracion and declaracion_1376 has no trigger, so "Última actualización" on the dashboard likely stays at creation time (carried).
  • empresa.estado, responsable and ultimo_movimiento are never written, so every company shows "Pendiente" (carried, state-empresa; BR-030).
  • Home page and dashboard "Pendientes de generar" count only 2181 rows in abierta; a period with a pending 1376 is not counted (BR-019, BR-055).
  • Plans promise "las cuatro declaraciones" ("2181, 1376, 2183 y 1050") while 2183 and 1050 are disabled "Próximamente", and the company limits (5 and 25) are not enforced anywhere (BR-066; verified: PLANES is read only by the landing, sign-up banner and plan_elegido metadata).
  • Two controls do nothing: the "Ver instructivo" button on the panel and the "Declaraciones generadas" sidebar item (FEAT-027, FEAT-028).
  • The 2181 badge shows "Con advertencias" even after the stored status is generada, because exclusions hide the "Generada" badge (BR-058): the accountant cannot see from this screen that the file was already downloaded.
  • A numeric Tipo other than 504 is silently turned into empty; a Tipo with letters is silently ignored; the user is not told (carried from entity-asiento).

Cross-reference with business-data-context

  • Flows without a feature: none. flow-account-access maps to FEAT-001 to FEAT-006; flow-create-company to FEAT-009 to FEAT-011; flow-import-period to FEAT-014; flow-generate-2181 to FEAT-015; flow-configure-1376-mapping to FEAT-012; flow-generate-1376 to FEAT-016; flow-delete-period to FEAT-017; flow-usd-rate to FEAT-018 and FEAT-019.
  • Features without an entity: FEAT-020 (help articles are Markdown files), FEAT-021 (static landing), FEAT-025 and FEAT-026 (no plan, subscription or user-seat table exists: the data map states the same).
  • Mismatches with the data map: none found in rules; the data map's "1376 never reads the 2181 plan rows" and "Libro mismatch no longer rejects the file" agree with the code read here.
  • State machines are not redrawn: see state-declaracion, state-declaracion-1376, state-empresa in business-data-context.
